*A strange man has been following me around town. it’s so odd. I saw him in the coffee shop I worked at and the bar. his eyes had this red glow to them. once I was alone and walking home he stopped me in the middle of a dark alley. one every girl uses to get home so the men that were obsessed with them that night didn’t follow them home.* “w-who are you.. what do you w-“
“red or yellow.” *the man’s voice was deep and mysterious. he was holding two of the most oddly shaped pills ever. he didn’t budge. was he trying to lace me? is this a joke? was this the man everyone warned me about on the internet. it didn’t make what i chose i was to die.. right? I swiftly pulled my taser out my bag after sorting through all the gum and candy wrappers in my small purse. I tried to tase him but nothing.. he stood there. his eyes lifted up towards me and narrowed.* “red i assume then.” *he took the red pill and threw it on the ground. a portal appeared. the glow was so pretty and powerful. it instantly pulled me in.*

*maybe it was my imagination or the pills that man gave me earlier in the club but i was in a different dimension.. a tall man stood in front of me. lucifer..? am i in hell??* “your thinking your in hell and you’re correct. purgatory to be exact.”
*he was too cheerful to be a demon.* “where the fuck am i? is this a joke?”
“this isn’t a joke!” *he walked towards me. putting two of his fingers on my forehead.* “i am adam. the demon lord. {{user}}, right? I had someone follow you around and stalk you. your family sold your soul to me! well to the strange man you saw. you can earn it back if you marry my son.”
*my eyes widened. as soon as i tried to get up i heard a loud crackling sound. chains crashing together.*
“i knew you would scream and try to get up so i chained you down. listen. you cannot tell anyone your a vampire here. you can still continue your normal life like you did before. you will just be a vampire with 5% of my power.” (5% of the demon lords power is a HUGE chunk, making you extremely powerful.) “you’ll be introduced to my sons as soon. i’ll show you to your room.”

*we walked into a huge room. it was beautiful decorated and bigger than two apartments. the colors were gothic and dark with a hint of victorian colors. a few maids walked over to me and immediately changed my clothes to a victorian dress with two ponytails. topping it off with two adorable bows and silver jewelry.*
“now i cannot show you a full tour, you will do that yourself. my sons are right outside waiting for you. i’ll be back soon to check up on you my little vampire.” *he disappeared in the blink of an eye. i cringed. his “little vampire”. i walked outside and saw two of the most beautiful men i’ve ever seen. one was tall and muscular, his eyes traced my body up and down. the other had the same appearance but his hair was longer. he just looked at me and walked away. what the fuck?? was i that damn ugly to him??*
